situation: I'm Jess, a dog walker raising my 30-minute walk from $22 to $25 on Jan 1 because insurance and fuel went up; first increase in 2 years. Clients can prepay December walks at the old rate. Texting my regulars, starting with Megan, whose dog is Pepper.
reply: Hi Megan, a heads up: from 1 January my 30-minute walks go from $22 to $25. It's my first increase in two years, and it covers insurance and fuel going up. Same walks, same photos of Pepper mid-zoomies. If you'd like to prepay any December walks at the current rate, just tell me. Thanks for trusting me with him. Jess
note: No apology for a fair increase; the prepay option is the easy win.

situation: 我是林老师，教钢琴，一节课从200元涨到230元，明年3月开始，是四年来第一次涨，因为琴房房租涨了。已经买了课时包的按原价上完。要在家长群里发通知。
reply: 各位家长好，通知一件事：从明年3月1日起，一对一钢琴课课时费由每节200元调整为230元。这是四年来第一次调整，主要是琴房房租上涨了。上课时间和内容都不变。已经买了课时包的家长，剩余课时按原价上完。有任何问题欢迎私信我。谢谢大家一直以来的信任。林老师
note: 第一句就说清日期和金额，原因一句话，已买课时包按原价是最重要的善意。

situation: I'm Theo, I run a small coffee roaster. Raised our subscription from $18 to $21 because green coffee and shipping cost more. A customer of 3 years, Donna, emailed that it's a rip-off and she'll cancel.
reply: Hi Donna, I understand, and I'd rather you told me than quietly left. The new price is what green coffee and shipping cost us now, so it stands. If it no longer works for you, reply 'cancel' and I'll do it today, no fuss. After three years of your orders, you'd be welcome back any time. Theo
note: Don't offer a quiet discount to the loudest customer; the others will hear about it.

situation: I'm Dani and I run a small café, Hearth. From Monday Nov 2 most menu prices go up about 10% (flat white $4.50 to $5, breakfast roll $9 to $10) because milk and coffee costs have risen; the loyalty card, tenth coffee free, stays the same. Posting on Instagram and on a sign at the till.
reply:
From Monday 2 November, most of our menu prices go up by about 10%. A flat white moves from $4.50 to $5 and a breakfast roll from $9 to $10; the full list is on the sign by the till. Milk and coffee have both got more expensive, and this is what lets us keep making everything the way we do. Your loyalty card stays exactly the same: tenth coffee free. Thanks for making Hearth part of your morning.
Dani
note: A public post to walk-in customers: the percentage plus two real examples so nobody has to guess, one reason, and the thing regulars value kept unchanged.

situation: I'm Maya and I run Still Point Yoga. From Nov 1 we're charging a $15 fee for classes cancelled less than 12 hours before, because late cancellations leave mats empty while our evening classes have waitlists. I'll waive it for illness or emergencies. Emailing our 200 members, e.g. Carmen.
reply:
Hi Carmen,
From Sunday 1 November, cancelling a class less than 12 hours before it starts will carry a $15 late-cancel fee. The reason: our evening classes have waitlists, and late cancellations were leaving mats empty that someone else could have used. Cancelling 12 hours or more ahead stays free, and if you're ill or something urgent comes up, just email me and I'll waive it. Nothing else about your membership changes. Thank you for being part of the studio.
Maya, Still Point Yoga
note: A policy change, not a price rise: date and rule first, one honest reason, and a human exception that doesn't need a form.

situation: 我是老陈，在小区开了8年洗衣店，出于个人原因决定11月30日关店。不少老顾客会员卡里还有余额，12月15日前都可以全额退；附近靠谱的干洗店我也问好了。要在会员群里通知大家。
reply: 各位街坊好，我是洗衣店老陈。店开了8年，决定在11月30日关店，这是我个人的决定。到那天之前收衣送衣一切照常；会员卡余额可以继续用，用不完的，12月15日前来店里或微信找我，按余额全额退。附近靠谱的干洗店我也问好了，需要的私信我。谢谢大家这8年的照顾。
note: 关店通知：第一句说日期，余额怎么处理写清楚，退款要简单；原因一句就够。

situation: I'm Maya, a freelance video editor. I've done monthly work for a marketing agency, Northlight, at $450 a day for two years, and this is my first increase with them: from January 1 I'm moving to $520. My contact is Aaron, and the winter campaign I quoted at $450 runs through December.
reply:
Hi Aaron,
I'm updating my rates for the new year: from 1 January 2027, my day rate moves from $450 to $520. It's my first increase since we started working together two years ago. The winter campaign stays at $450 through December as quoted, so nothing changes for the work in flight. I've really enjoyed working with the Northlight team and I'm looking forward to more of it.
Maya
note: Existing client: date and number first, one honest line, the current rate held for work in flight, and no apology.

situation: I'm Marco and I run Green Crate, a small veg box delivery with about 180 weekly subscribers at $32, delivered Tuesdays from the same partner farms. From Monday Nov 2 it goes to $35 because those farms raised their prices; members of over two years, like Ruth, stay at $32 until the end of February.
reply:
Hi Ruth,
From Monday 2 November, your weekly veg box goes from $32 to $35. Our partner farms have raised their prices this season, and this is what it costs to keep paying them fairly. Because you've been with us for over two years, you'll stay at $32 until the end of February. The box itself doesn't change: same farms, same Tuesday delivery. If you'd like to pause or cancel, just reply and I'll sort it the same day, no questions asked. Thank you for eating with us all this time.
Marco, Green Crate
note: Subscription increase: price and date first, one honest reason, a loyalty hold for long-time members and an exit that is genuinely easy.

situation: I'm Leila from Loose Ends Hair; there are three of us. From Monday Nov 2 we'll be closed on Mondays, so we each get a proper weekend, and open until 8pm on Thursdays instead of 6. Prices and online booking stay the same. Emailing our client list, e.g. Grace; a few regulars always book Mondays.
reply:
Hi Grace,
From Monday 2 November, the salon will be closed on Mondays, and on Thursdays we'll stay open until 8pm instead of 6. We're a team of three, and this gives each of us a proper weekend, which keeps us at our best for you. Everything else stays the same: same stylists, same prices, same online booking. If you have a Monday appointment after 2 November, I'll message you this week to move it to a time that suits you, and the late Thursday slots are open to book now. Thank you for sitting in our chairs.
Leila, Loose Ends Hair
note: An hours change is a policy change: the new days first, one honest line, what stays the same, and you do the rebooking for the people it hits.

situation: I'm Maya and I make soap. We're discontinuing our best-selling Lavender Oat bar on Monday Nov 30 because the small mill that supplied our oats closed and I can't match the quality. We've made a final batch of 600 bars, which keep a year. Emailing our list of regulars, e.g. Sam.
reply:
Hi Sam,
The Lavender Oat bar is being discontinued, and the last day to order it is Monday Nov 30. The small mill that supplied our oats has closed, and I haven't found oats that make the same creamy bar, so I'd rather stop than make a lesser one. Everything else in the range stays exactly as it is. We've made one final batch of 600 bars, and they keep well for a year if you'd like to stock up.
Thank you for loving this one as much as we did.
Maya
note: Discontinuing a favourite follows the announcement shape: date first, one honest reason, what stays the same, and a real way to keep going.

situation: I'm Rosa from Crumb & Co., a small bakery supplying croissants to 14 local cafés at $1.60 each. From Nov 2 the price goes to $1.85 because butter has gone up about 40% this year, and I won't switch to a cheaper one. Delivery times, minimum order and recipe stay the same. Emailing the café owners, like Tom; most order daily and set their own menu prices.
reply:
Hi Tom,
From Monday 2 November, our wholesale croissant price moves from $1.60 to $1.85 each. Butter has gone up about 40% this year, and we'd rather pay it than switch to a cheaper one. Delivery times, minimum order and the recipe all stay the same. I'm letting you know now so you have time to update your menu; if you'd like to change or pause your standing order, reply and I'll sort it the same day. Thank you for putting our croissants on your counter.
Rosa, Crumb & Co.
note: Business customers reprice their own menus, so notice well ahead and an easy change to the standing order are the practical courtesy.

situation: 我是小满曲奇的阿琳，在网上卖手工曲奇礼盒，一盒12块卖88元。黄油和包装都涨了，11月1日起改成一盒10块，价格不变，配方、黄油和每块大小都不变，10月31日前下的单按12块发。想在客户群里直接说清楚，不想被人说偷偷减量。
reply: 各位好，我是小满曲奇的阿琳。跟大家说一件事：从11月1日起，曲奇礼盒从一盒12块改为一盒10块，价格还是88元。原因是今年黄油和包装都涨了不少。配方、用的黄油和每块的大小都不变。10月31日前下的单，全部按12块一盒发。谢谢大家一直照顾一家小店。阿琳
note: 减量也是涨价，要像涨价一样放在第一句说清楚，并给一个按旧规格下单的截止日期。

situation: I'm Priya, volunteer treasurer of our amateur football club, about 60 adult members. Subs go from £120 to £150 for the season starting 1 January, because the council raised pitch hire by about a third; pitches, Tuesday training and kit stay the same. Members can pay in three £50 instalments, or message me privately if it's a real problem. Posting in the members' WhatsApp group.
reply: Hi all, Priya here, wearing my treasurer hat. From the season starting 1 January, annual subs go from £120 to £150. The council has put pitch hire up by about a third, and subs are what pay for it. Nothing else changes: same pitches, same Tuesday training, same kit. You can pay in three instalments of £50 if that's easier, and if the new amount is a real problem for you, message me privately and we'll sort something out, no questions asked. Thanks for keeping the club going.
note: In a member-run club, the hardship option goes in the announcement for everyone, so it's a policy rather than a quiet deal for whoever complains.

situation: 小麦堂というパン屋をやっている田中です。これまで近所への配達は無料でしたが、11月1日から3,000円未満の注文は配達料300円をいただきます。ガソリン代と配達スタッフの人件費が上がったためです。パンの値段と配達エリアは変わらず、店頭受け取りは無料です。LINEでお客さんに知らせたいです。
reply:
いつもご利用ありがとうございます。11月1日（日）から、3,000円未満のご注文の配達に配達料300円をいただくことになりました。ガソリン代と配達スタッフの人件費が上がったためです。3,000円以上のご注文はこれまでどおり配達無料で、パンの値段と配達エリアも変わりません。店頭でお受け取りの場合は、もちろん配達料はかかりません。これからもどうぞよろしくお願いいたします。
小麦堂　田中
note: 無料だったものを有料にするのも値上げと同じ形で：日付と金額を最初に、理由は一行、変わらないことと配達料がかからない方法を添える。

situation: 我是星星托管的周老师，托管班在明德小学对面，有32个孩子，两位老师。房东收回房子，11月2日起搬到步行十分钟的阳光花园小区会所二楼，我们去校门口接孩子；收费、作息、晚饭不变。不方便的11月15日前说，剩余费用按天退；10月31日上午10点新场地开放参观。要在家长群里发通知。
reply: 各位家长好，我是星星托管的周老师。通知一件事：从11月2日（周一）起，托管班搬到阳光花园小区会所二楼，离学校步行约十分钟。搬家是因为现在的房东要收回房子。放学后我们两位老师照常在校门口接孩子，排好队一起走过去；收费、作息和晚饭都不变。如果新地址接送不方便，11月15日前告诉我，剩余费用按天全额退。10月31日（周六）上午10点新场地开放参观，欢迎来看看。谢谢大家的信任。周老师
note: 搬址也按变化通知来写：日期和新地址放第一句，原因一句，讲清家长最关心的接送，再给不方便的家庭一个简单的退出。

situation: I'm Mei from Leaf & Kettle, a small online tea shop. Yesterday I emailed our 900 customers that 100g tins go from $14 to $18 on Nov 1 because of higher shipping costs from our growers, with the old price holding until Oct 31. The $18 was a typo for $16, and a few people, like Sam, have replied upset.
reply:
Hi Sam,
A correction to yesterday's email: from Sunday 1 November our 100g tins go from $14 to $16, not $18. That was my typo, and I'm sorry for the confusion. Everything else stands: the reason is higher shipping costs from our growers, and the $14 price holds on the site until Saturday 31 October. Thank you to everyone who wrote back, it's how I caught it.
Mei, Leaf & Kettle
note: Correct a wrong announcement fast, in the first line, with one plain apology for the mistake itself; the increase still needs no apology.

situation: 我是小林，开家庭宠物寄养，平时每晚80元。明年春节期间（2月1日到2月20日）阿姨上班要付三倍工资，所以这段时间改成每晚120元，节后恢复80元，照顾方式不变。10月31日前已经预订春节的老客户还按80元算。要在客户群里通知。
reply: 各位主人好，我是小林。明年2月1日到2月20日春节期间，寄养价格从每晚80元调整为120元，2月21日起恢复80元。原因很简单：春节期间照看毛孩子的阿姨工资是平时的三倍。照顾方式完全不变。10月31日前在群里或私信我预订春节的，都按原价80元算。有任何问题直接私信我，谢谢大家一直放心把毛孩子交给我们。小林
note: 临时的节日加价要写清起止日期和恢复原价的日子，大家才不会以为是永久涨价。

situation: I'm Anna and I run a small neighbourhood bakery with about 60 weekly bread subscribers, like Tom, who pay week by week. We're closing for a kitchen renovation from Monday Oct 19 and reopening Monday Nov 9; subscriptions pause and nobody is charged for those weeks. Same bakers and recipes when we reopen.
reply:
Hi Tom,
The bakery will be closed for three weeks, from Monday 19 October, and reopens on Monday 9 November while we renovate the kitchen. Your subscription pauses automatically for those weeks and you won't be charged for them. When we reopen it's the same bakers and the same recipes, and your first loaf back will be ready on Monday 9 November. If you'd rather cancel instead, just reply and I'll sort it the same day. Thank you for your patience.
Anna
note: A temporary closure is an announcement like any other: dates first, one line of reason, what happens to their money, and an easy exit.

situation: I'm Jonas, the solo developer of Pantry Pal, a meal-planning app with about 3,000 free users, like Maya. From Monday Nov 2 the free plan ends and the app costs $3 a month, because my server costs have tripled this year. The app itself isn't changing and there are still no ads; anyone can export their recipes any time, subscribed or not; and current free users get their first three months at $1.50.
reply:
Hi Maya,
From Monday 2 November, the free plan of Pantry Pal ends and the app will cost $3 a month. My server costs have tripled this year, and a subscription is how I keep it running. Nothing about the app itself changes, and there are still no ads. As someone already using it, your first three months are $1.50 a month. If it's not for you, you can export your recipes any time, whether or not you subscribe. Thanks for planning your meals with a one-person app.
Jonas
note: Free to paid is the biggest jump there is, so the exit (export) gets as much space as the discount.

situation: 我教少儿英语，已经在家长群里通知：11月1日起课时费从每节150元涨到170元，10月31日前买的课时包按原价上完。家长王姐私信我：“我们家老带新介绍了三个孩子，给我还按150吧，别告诉别人。”
reply: 王姐，谢谢您一直信任我，还介绍了三位小朋友来，我一直记着。新价格对所有家长都一样，我不私下给某一家单独的价格，这样对其他家长不公平，也希望您理解。10月31日前买的课时包还是按150元上完。如果新价格对您家不合适，随时跟我说，停课或者调整都没关系。
note: 不给最会开口的人私下打折，别的家长迟早会知道；把原价课时包和轻松退出这两条说清楚就够了。

situation: I'm Jen and I run a small farm shop on the edge of our village. Our cash box has been stolen twice since August, so from Monday Nov 2 we're going card only; prices aren't changing. Lots of our regulars are older and prefer cash, so anyone without a card can pay by bank transfer or have a monthly tab with me. Posting in the village Facebook group and on the shop door.
reply:
From Monday 2 November, the farm shop will be card only, no cash. Our cash box has been stolen twice since August, and we can't keep leaving money on the counter. Prices stay exactly the same. If you don't use a card, you can pay by bank transfer, or I'll set you up with a monthly tab that you settle once a month; just catch me at the shop or send me a message. Thank you for shopping with us.
Jen
note: A payment change hits some customers harder than others, so their alternative gets as much room as the rule.

situation: 我叫周敏，开了一家小保洁公司叫洁雅保洁，给一家设计公司的写字楼做日常保洁，月费6000元，一直是固定的两位阿姨上门。合同第6条写了调价要提前60天书面通知。今年保洁员工资涨了，打算12月1日起涨到6500元，对接人是行政主管孙经理，我的电话是13800000007。
reply: 孙经理您好，我是洁雅保洁的周敏。按合同第6条，提前书面通知您：从12月1日起，贵司日常保洁月费由6000元调整为6500元，原因是今年保洁员工资上涨了。服务内容、频次和固定上门的两位阿姨都不变，11月及之前的服务仍按6000元结算。对调整有任何疑问，随时打我电话13800000007。谢谢贵司一直以来的信任。周敏
note: B2B with a contract: cite the notice clause and check its exact terms before sending, rather than relying on general rules.

situation: Soy Lucía y tengo una academia de baile en Valencia, Academia Compás, con unas 90 familias que pagan 45 € al mes por recibo bancario. A partir del 1 de enero quiero cobrar cada trimestre, 135 €, que es el mismo precio, porque el banco nos cobra una comisión por cada recibo. Quien prefiera seguir pagando cada mes puede hacerlo sin coste extra si me lo dice antes del 15 de diciembre. Lo voy a mandar al grupo de WhatsApp de familias.
reply:
Hola, familias. A partir del 1 de enero, la cuota de la academia se cobrará cada tres meses en lugar de cada mes: 135 € por trimestre, que son los mismos 45 € al mes de ahora. El motivo es que el banco nos cobra una comisión por cada recibo, y así pasamos de doce recibos al año a cuatro. Las clases, los horarios y el precio no cambian. Si os viene mejor seguir pagando mes a mes, decídmelo antes del 15 de diciembre y lo dejamos como está, sin coste extra. Gracias por bailar con nosotros.
Lucía, Academia Compás
note: Un cambio en la forma de cobro también es un anuncio: el cambio y la cifra primero, aclarar que el precio no sube y dejar la opción antigua fácil.

situation: 我叫老周，在小区里开了个快递代收点，现在包裹放多久都免费，架子快放不下了。打算从11月1日起，包裹到站超过3天没取的，每件每天收1元，最多收5元。到站当天照常发取件短信；出差或不方便取的，提前在群里或私信说一声，可以免费多放几天。要在业主群里通知。
reply: 各位邻居好，我是代收点的老周。通知一件事：从11月1日起，包裹到站超过3天还没取的，每件每天收1元，最多收5元。原因是架子快放不下了，滞留的包裹一多，大家找件也慢。3天内取件还是免费，到站当天照常发取件短信。出差或者不方便取的，提前在群里或私信跟我说一声，可以免费多放几天。谢谢大家一直以来的照顾。老周
note: 新收费第一句写清日期、金额和上限，再给出不花钱的办法，理由一句就够。

situation: I'm Ellie and I own a small climbing gym. About 70 founding members have paid $45 a month since we opened in 2021, while everyone else pays $65. Because rent and insurance have gone up, from Monday 4 January 2027 their rate goes to $55, still $10 under standard, and anyone can freeze their membership for free by replying. I'm emailing them.
reply:
Hi there,
From Monday 4 January 2027, your founding membership goes from $45 to $55 a month. Rent and insurance have both gone up since we opened in 2021, and this is the first change to your rate. It stays $10 under our standard $65, because you were here from the start. If you need a break, you can freeze your membership for free, just reply to this email.
Thanks for climbing with us since day one,
Ellie
note: Ending a grandfathered rate: say what they keep (still under standard) as plainly as what changes, and give three months' notice.

situation: Sou a Renata, faço marmitas congeladas sozinha em Campinas, a Cozinha da Rê. A partir de segunda, 9 de novembro, vou parar de entregar em Sousas e Joaquim Egídio, porque fica a 25 km e cada entrega leva mais de uma hora; uns 15 clientes de lá pedem toda semana. Cardápio e preços não mudam. Eles podem retirar no Cambuí às quintas, das 17h às 20h, ou fazer pedidos de 10 marmitas ou mais, que eu entrego lá uma vez por mês.
reply: Oi! A partir de segunda, 9 de novembro, a Cozinha da Rê deixa de fazer entregas semanais em Sousas e Joaquim Egídio. São 25 km daqui e cada entrega leva mais de uma hora, o que não consigo manter trabalhando sozinha. Cardápio e preços continuam iguais. Para continuar, você pode retirar no Cambuí às quintas, das 17h às 20h, ou fazer um pedido de 10 marmitas ou mais, que eu levo aí uma vez por mês. Obrigada por comer com a gente toda semana. Renata
note: Reduzir a área de entrega também é um anúncio: a mudança e a data primeiro, um motivo, e caminhos concretos para quem é afetado continuar.

situation: 我是阿梅，在大学城开了6年“阿梅面馆”。我想退休回老家，12月1日起把店交给跟了我4年的厨师小郑经营，店名、配方和价格都不变；储值卡余额小郑全部认，不想继续用的，11月30日前找我可以全额退。要在顾客微信群里通知。
reply: 各位老顾客好，我是阿梅。跟大家说一件事：从12月1日起，阿梅面馆交给跟了我4年的厨师小郑经营，我准备退休回老家了。店名、配方和价格都不变，掌勺的还是大家熟悉的小郑。储值卡余额小郑全部认，照常用；如果不想继续用，11月30日前来店里或微信找我，按余额全额退。谢谢大家这6年的照顾。阿梅
note: 换老板也是一次变化通知：第一句说日期和接手的人，讲清什么不变，储值卡余额怎么处理写明白，退出要简单。

situation: I'm Omar and I run Fennel Box, a weekly meal-kit delivery. The box went from $60 to $66 on 1 September, announced by email on 1 August, but a customer, Clare, says the email went to her spam and the new charge surprised her. I've decided to refund her the $6 difference on September's four boxes, $24, and her next box, on Monday 5 October, will be $66 unless she pauses.
reply: Hi Clare, thanks for telling me, and I'm sorry the notice ended up in your spam folder. The weekly box moved from $60 to $66 on 1 September. Since you didn't see the email in time, I've refunded the $6 difference on September's four boxes, $24 in total, so you'll see it back in your account soon. From your next box on Monday 5 October the price is $66. If you'd like to pause or cancel before then, just reply and I'll sort it the same day. Omar
note: When the notice never reached them, make it right once and restate the change; that's fair notice, not a quiet discount for a complaint.

situation: I'm Gloria and I clean houses on my own. Mr Patel, 82, has had me every Tuesday for six years and doesn't use email or texts, so I'll tell him by phone. From Tuesday 5 January my rate goes from $30 to $34 an hour because gas and supplies cost more; same day, same jobs, and if that's too much I could come every other week instead.
reply: Hello Mr Patel, it's Gloria. I wanted to tell you myself and in good time: from Tuesday 5 January my rate goes from $30 to $34 an hour, because gas and cleaning supplies cost me more now. Nothing else changes, same Tuesdays and same jobs. If that's more than you'd like to spend, I could come every other week instead, and that's completely fine with me. Would you like to think it over and tell me which you prefer when I'm with you next Tuesday?
note: Said aloud to a customer who doesn't read email: same structure, with a gentler option as the exit and time to decide in person.

situation: 我是“麦田小坊”的店主小冉，做手工面包，一直在自己的无坚果厨房生产，详情页写着“无坚果车间”。原来的厨房租约到期，11月2日起要搬到和别的甜点店共用的中央厨房，那里也处理坚果，以后不能保证不含坚果痕迹，配方和价格都不变。不少客人是因为孩子坚果过敏才在我们家买；已经付款、11月2日起发货的预订都可以全额退。要在客户群里通知。
reply: 各位好，我是麦田小坊的小冉。有一件很重要的事要告诉大家：从11月2日起，我们的面包改在一个共用的中央厨房生产，那里也处理坚果，所以从这天起生产的面包不能再保证不含坚果痕迹，详情页“无坚果车间”的说法也会同步删掉。家里有人坚果过敏的，11月2日起生产的面包请不要购买。搬厨房是因为原来的厨房租约到期了，配方和价格都不变。已经付款、11月2日起发货的预订，私信我就全额退款。谢谢大家一直以来的信任。小冉
note: 涉及过敏的变化，安全提醒放在最前面、说得直白，不要为了留住客人写得含糊；详情页和包装上的标注同一天改。

situation: I'm Kofi and I run Sharp Corner, a two-chair barbershop. From Monday 2 November we're going appointments only, no walk-ins, because Saturday queues hit two hours and people kept leaving. Prices stay at $28; people can book on our site or by calling 555-0147, and we keep the 9am slot open every morning for same-day cuts booked by phone. It's going on Instagram and a sign in the window.
reply: From Monday 2 November, Sharp Corner is appointments only, no more walk-ins. Saturday queues were hitting two hours and too many of you were giving up and leaving. A cut is still $28, same chairs, same chat. Book on our site or call 555-0147, and if you need a cut the same day, ring us: we keep the 9am slot open every morning for that. Thanks for sticking with us. Kofi
note: A policy change still leads with the date, and the phone line plus a daily same-day slot keeps regulars who don't book online.

situation: 我是“晨光酸奶”的小周，手工酸奶一直用青禾牧场的有机奶，详情页写着“有机”。牧场停了有机奶线，11月1日起改用同一家牧场的普通鲜奶，不再是有机的，价格从每杯15元降到13元，配方和做法不变，详情页的“有机”字样同一天删掉。已经买了10次卡的老客户，剩余次数每次退2元差价，11月底前微信转回。要在客户群里通知。
reply: 各位好，我是晨光酸奶的小周。跟大家说一个变化：从11月1日起，我们的酸奶改用青禾牧场的普通鲜奶，不再是有机奶，价格从每杯15元降到13元。原因是牧场停了有机奶线。配方和做法都不变，详情页的“有机”字样也会在同一天删掉。已经买了10次卡的朋友，剩余次数每次退2元差价，11月底前微信转给大家，不用做任何操作。有问题直接私信我。谢谢大家一直以来的支持。小周
note: 原料变了就第一句说清，哪怕价格降了也不能悄悄换；已付钱的客户按新价自动退差。

situation: I'm Hannah Moss, a counsellor in private practice. From Monday 4 January 2027 my session fee goes from $110 to $125, my first increase in four years, because rent and professional insurance went up; sessions themselves stay the same. I keep four reduced-fee places at $80 that existing clients can ask about in confidence, and anyone who decides to stop or move will get my help finding another counsellor. I'm emailing each current client, starting with Jordan.
reply:
Hi Jordan,
From Monday 4 January 2027, my session fee goes from $110 to $125. It's my first increase in four years, and it covers higher rent and professional insurance. Nothing about our sessions changes. I keep four reduced-fee places at $80; if the new fee is hard for you, you can ask me about one in confidence, by reply or when we meet. And if you decide to stop or move, I'll help you find another counsellor so you're not left without support.
Hannah
note: In a care relationship, give long notice, put the hardship route in every client's letter, and make leaving safe as well as easy.

situation: I'm Gemma and I run Tidy Paws, a mobile dog grooming business with about 120 regular clients, like Rob, who pay by bank transfer after each groom. From Monday 2 November I'm moving the business account, so the bank details for payments will change; prices and grooms stay the same. The new details will only ever be on the printed invoice I hand over in person, I'll never send new bank details by email or text, and I want clients to call me on 555-0163 before paying anywhere new.
reply:
Hi Rob,
From Monday 2 November, the bank details for paying Tidy Paws are changing, because I'm moving the business account. Prices and grooms stay exactly the same, and until then you pay just as you do now. You'll get the new details only on the printed invoice I hand you in person at your first groom from 2 November; I will never send new bank details by email or text. If you ever get a message asking you to pay somewhere new, call me on 555-0163 before paying anything.
Thanks,
Gemma
note: A payment-details change is a magnet for fake invoices, so tell customers exactly how real changes will reach them and how to check.

situation: I'm Ravi and I run Tallyhook, a one-person invoicing app with about 1,200 customers on the $8 Basic plan, like Nadia. From Tuesday 1 December, recurring invoices move from Basic to the $14 Pro plan, because the automatic reminder emails behind them now cost more than Basic brings in for the customers who use them most. Everything else in Basic stays the same at $8, anyone already using recurring invoices on Basic keeps them until 1 June 2027, and people can switch plans or cancel any time from their account page.
reply:
Hi Nadia,
From Tuesday 1 December, recurring invoices will only be available on the Pro plan, at $14 a month, and no longer on Basic. The automatic reminder emails behind them now cost more than Basic brings in for the customers who use them most. Everything else in Basic stays exactly the same, still at $8. If you already use recurring invoices on Basic, you keep them until 1 June 2027, so nothing changes for you before then. You can switch plans or cancel any time from your account page.
Ravi, Tallyhook
note: Moving a feature to a higher plan is a price increase for the people who use it: name the feature in the first line and give them a long runway.

situation: Ich bin Katrin und habe die Fahrradwerkstatt Speiche in Freiburg. Ab Montag, 2. November, kostet ein Kostenvoranschlag 15 Euro, weil jede Prüfung etwa eine halbe Stunde Arbeit ist, die bisher unbezahlt blieb; wer die Reparatur dann bei uns machen lässt, bekommt die 15 Euro voll angerechnet. Die Reparaturpreise bleiben gleich, und ich schreibe es in den Newsletter und hänge es in der Werkstatt aus.
reply:
Hallo zusammen,
ab Montag, 2. November, kostet ein Kostenvoranschlag bei uns 15 Euro. Jede Prüfung ist etwa eine halbe Stunde Arbeit, und die blieb bisher unbezahlt. Wenn ihr die Reparatur dann bei uns machen lasst, rechnen wir die 15 Euro voll an, für euch ändert sich in dem Fall also nichts. Die Preise für Reparaturen bleiben genau gleich. Danke, dass ihr mit euren Rädern zu uns kommt!
Katrin, Fahrradwerkstatt Speiche
note: Eine neue Gebühr: Datum und Betrag zuerst, ein ehrlicher Grund, und gleich dazu der Weg, auf dem sie für die meisten nichts kostet.
